identity: Bannerbreak Mesa is where the orcs carry the Throng's banners to the front; hyenas, goblins and old dead fight over everything those banners leave behind.

quests.title: Yarra Keeps the Names
quests.text: Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold needs help with the people who march under her banners. Go and speak to her. She can tell you who carried each one, who mended it, and which fool dragged it through a cooking fire.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Rattle's Bad Arithmetic
quests.text: {name:provisioner_rattle} stole wagonloads meant for my ramp crews and the guild workers, and he is selling them out of the {name:supply_camp}. Find him, {dir_from_giver:provisioner_rattle}, and kill him. My people did their work; he does not get to sell their supper and tomorrow's tools for doing none.
quests.completion: Rattle is finished, but his theft has left beams waiting for hands, guild workers waiting for tools and carriers with empty loads. We can begin putting that work back in order now. At least he will not be taking a cut of it.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (round61-plan.md §2 point 2: T4's free prerequisite); free, it requires nothing; its one Throng follow-up is T4. Only Rattle now (the check: the Sapper and Slinger count goes), the leader at 35 (subtypes.json). The zone's weapon (§2a point 6).

quests.title: Word for Thunderstep
quests.text: Rumela Stormstep at Thunderstep Watch in Thunderroot Wilds keeps word passing between the carriers and the crews waiting for them. Go and offer her help. A banner can tell them where we stand; sometimes they would also like to know whether supper is coming.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: A Soldier's Due
quests.text: The Trench Mummies still stand their old watch in the {name:redcut_flats}, {zone_area:redcut_flats}. Put four of them to rest. I sew the fallen's names into our banners so we can carry their memory; they have stood long enough.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays; free, no prerequisite, required by nothing (draft §4.5); not the camp hunt's role (Muster Husks).

quests.title: Party: The Banner-Eater
quests.text: I stitch our fallen's names into the banners, and {name:banner_eater} has been tearing them down to eat. Gather a group and kill him at the {name:goblin_warcamp}, {dir_from_giver:banner_eater}. There are people I remember by the last stitch I made for them, and I will not leave that stitch in his teeth.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone (its old prerequisite is gone), a trinket choice as its extra.

quests.title: The Hands Behind the Stores
quests.text: Rattle will steal no more loads, but the ramp crews, guards and guild workers are still short of what was promised. The handover record for the transport raided on its run through the {name:warplains} should show each crew's share. Secure it at the {name:scattered_load}, {dir_from_giver:scattered_load}, and take it to Greda Stonehaul, the foreman at Bannerbreak Mining Camp. My crews have done their work, and I want to tell them what they can still expect.
quests.completion: Here are the shares for the ramp crews, the guards and our guild workers; each one is still owed its delivery. The Oathdelvers will arrange replacements with the army's suppliers. I will record the load as taken in the raid, with no debt laid on the carriers who lost it.
quests.lesson: Chapter 3 of the story arc (story, may chain).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. T4 (story, 35): requires T3 and Rattle's free quest (its one Throng follow-up); turned in at the Bannerbreak mining camp's foreman, titled Greda Stonehaul (K13 A).

quests.title: Too Warm for Wages
quests.text: Our riders left an intercepted pay box at {name:r20_anchor_074}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_074}, when its coins burned through their gloves. Break the requisition seal: The Accord has put its stamp on something it ought to explain. Kill three Coal-Purse Factors by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}. Report to Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post; his crews keep digging up boxes like it.

quests.title: An Oath in Hock
quests.text: Grave coin under a seal of The Accord: they are buying themselves a cheaper army, and I want the proof in my fist. Yarra Standardmender says the dead on The Shattered Line salute a standard pledged against the next payment. Kill three Brandbound Collectors at night in the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}. Unpick the pledged standard at {name:r20_anchor_081} and take the stitching to Yarra at Tornstandard Hold; she reads cloth the way I read a liar.

quests.title: Find the Hand That Signed
quests.text: A bought oath is a debt with a blade on it. Ours were never for sale. Ninepins's pledge slips bear seals of The Accord; {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, who holds The Accord's high camp on The Shattered Line, should know whose hand signed them. Kill the captain at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, {dir_from_giver:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, and bring me the Accord Captain's Orders; I need the paper more than a story about the fight.

quests.title: Our Tallykeeper's Treason
quests.text: The Accord's orders call for a hunt on the soot factors and list their own soldiers burned by the factors' pay: they have been robbed and burned too. Worse, the seized grave coin carries our own war-chest tally marks, entered by Tallykeeper Mardra, who left last winter 'to collect what the dead were owed'. I struck her name from our roll before the whole drill yard; everyone heard who sold our dead. Bury the seized branded pay unspent at {name:kragmar_thunderroot_wilds/coinpit_hollow}, {dir_of:r20_anchor_048:kragmar_thunderroot_wilds/coinpit_hollow}; The Accord will not lock our shame in its evidence chest.

quests.title: Party: Greyvow's Last Filing
quests.text: The captured orders send War Commander Greyvow to run The Accord's hunt from the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}. He means to seize the payers and every scrap that tells what they did to our dead. Gather a party and kill him among his garrison; he is an elite commander with plenty of blades behind his paperwork. We will tell our own story in our own yard.

quests.title: Still Buying Our Dead
quests.text: Mardra sold our dead, and somebody is still buying. Kill three Kiln-Whisper Hexers at night in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, and report to Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise; she says the fen's dead whisper about fire, and the hexers do the whispering. Nalo Pathdrum in Kezamba is watching Chirr's archers in The Skyglass Canopy and will have work for you once Vaska has your report.

quests.title: Party: No Claim on Our Dead
quests.text: Isquarre the Tithe-Eater has come to {name:r20_anchor_077} to claim our dead, and he will not have even Mardra. That debt is ours to judge, not his. Gather a party of two or three, kill him beside the burning crack and stay out of it; if The Accord turns up, it can carry its own banner home, and we will carry ours. Report to Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch afterwards, so she can hear what his fall leaves behind.
